name: Extended Phase Range SLM Modulation
aliases: Depth Replica Removal via Extended Phase Range
Extended Phase Range SLM for Depth Replica Reduction
definition: A technique to reduce depth replicas (ghost images) in holograms by using an SLM with an extended phase range, which diminishes the intensity of replica planes compared to standard 0-2$\pi$ phase range SLMs.
summary: Extended Phase Range SLM Modulation reduces depth replicas in color holography by exploiting wavelength-dependent phase dispersion in liquid crystal devices, unlike standard methods that use uniform 0-2pi ranges.
